evidence.quoted_text:
if not re.fullmatch(r'[0-9a-f]{40}', target):
        raise ValueError('target must be a full commit SHA')
evidence.reason: `verify_target()` only enforces the 40-character lowercase-hex shape before using the target as a Git revision. An annotated tag object ID also matches that regex, and when `--tag` is omitted there is no `git cat-file -t`/peel check requiring the object itself to be a commit. Git revision operations can peel that tag object for ancestry and tree inspection, while the recorded/returned target remains the tag object ID rather than the commit checked out. The validation therefore does not enforce its own documented requirement that `target` be a full commit SHA.
